prompt: It is becoming increasingly popular to have a year Off between finishing school and going to university. What are the advantages and disadvantages Of this?
essay:
Nowadays, many people argue about the idea of having a break between finishing high school and going to university. So, this essay will demonstrate how a gap year can be beneficial for some students, but also how it can lead to complications for them when they continue studying.

A gap year can be very beneficial for students after finishing high school. It can help them to travel, gain work experience or just take a break to unwind after all the pressures of 18 years. For instance, in France, the president tried to encourage people to take a break. In addition, there are many forums presenting some specific programs for going abroad to work, to do volunteering, or just to find themselves. Additionally, it gives some the chance to discover other things beyond what they have learned, to understand the world.

But this period of time can lead to difficulties in restarting studies after a long time without any academic pressure, which can encourage many to continue without pursuing further studies. Furthermore,  it can change their mindset about their future life and ambitions and decrease their motivation. For example, in 2015, in Belgium, the education minister did not give students the opportunity to do a gap year because  it would be difficult to integrate into a well-known university because of the strict selection process.

To conclude, this period of time can be essential for some people, but it can create some difficulties for others to restart a new routine. Finally, it depends on one's goals and ambitions.
